title: Module 2: Cognitive Load & Schema
description: Examine how working memory limits, schema development, and instructional presentation choices interact to support or overload learners.

learning_objectives.statement: Explain the three types of cognitive load: intrinsic, extraneous, and germane
Understand schema theory and its role in information processing
Identify design decisions that reduce overload and support schema formation

alignment_method: deterministic lexical mapping v2 with direct-evidence fallback; instructor review required
